[Gary A. Wagner]{.name}

[Acadiana Business Economist/BORSF Eminent Scholar Endowed Chair\
University of Louisiana at Lafayette]{.role}

I am an applied economist working on regional economics and state and local public finance, with a focus on economic development, entrepreneurship, and political economy. Before joining UL Lafayette, I was Vice President and Senior Regional Officer at the Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland.
